name: The Crucible — machine replication ledger
description: Scientific and technical claims rebuilt as minimal computational models and tested. REPRODUCED = the mechanism holds in a minimal model; FAILED = it does not; NOT_COMPUTABLE = no simulable core (an honest pass).

entries.claim: A big-enough context window replaces retrieval (CAG / "RAG is dead"): preload the whole corpus into long context and "it must be somewhere" => the model answers correctly.
entries.source: CAG / "long context kills RAG" viral discourse; CAG paper = Chan et al. 2024 (arXiv:2412.15605), which itself scopes replacement to small constrained knowledge bases.
entries.note: Judge-free probe on one synthetic structured log at 5k/25k/60k/110k tokens, two task families. NEEDLE (single-fact lookup) = 1.00 at every length incl. 110k; SYNTH (read-everything count/filter aggregation) collapses 0.75->~0.25-0.375 by ~25k and stays there. Verdict FAILED for CAG *on synthesis*; needle lookup survives long context fine, so blanket "context rot kills recall" is also too strong. It is the task type, not the length. Replicates lost-in-the-middle (Liu 2023/TACL 2024), RULER (Hsieh/NVIDIA 2024), NoLiMa (2502.05167), Chroma context-rot (2025, non-peer-reviewed). HONEST LIMITS: n=8 synth Qs/length (the 0.75->0.3 drop is Fisher p~0.13, credible mainly by matching the replicated literature); one frontier model (exact model not logged); even at 5k synth is 0.75 so part of the failure is exhaustive arithmetic the model cannot do at any length -> the real fix for count/filter is a TOOL, not retrieval. Probe: mnemo/probes/ragdead (generator + independent gold-re-derivation scorer). Post: public/posts/does-long-context-kill-rag.html.

entries.claim: Internet AS-level topology follows a power-law degree distribution
entries.source: Faloutsos et al. 1999 SIGCOMM; tested vs exponential/log-normal via Clauset-Shalizi-Newman 2009 SIAM Rev., cf. Broido & Clauset 2019 Nat Commun 10:1017
entries.note: Real 2000 AS data (SNAP, 6474 nodes), CSN MLE: power-law (alpha=2.15, matches Faloutsos exponent) beats exponential (p=0.0002) but ties log-normal (p=0.616, NS). Confirms Broido-Clauset: <5% of networks are truly scale-free.

entries.claim: Chatbot Arena (LMArena) Elo ranks LLMs by genuine answer quality, so Arena rank is a valid model-selection signal.
entries.source: Chiang et al. 2024, Chatbot Arena, arXiv:2403.04132
entries.note: Style-only null on real public votes (lmarena-ai/arena-human-preference-140k, 28,084 decided battles). Two opposing findings. VOTES: a style-only judge (length+markdown, no model identity/content) predicts the human winner 61.5%, and the longer answer wins ~62% even between the SAME two models (>=50 battles/pair: 63.3%) -- a genuine per-vote length bias. ORDER: style-only rank reproduces Spearman rho=0.74 of the leaderboard, but that is a correlational CEILING (style co-moves with quality) and LMSYS's style-CONTROLLED Elo reorders only modestly -> the leaderboard ORDER is mostly skill. VERDICT REVISED FAILED->REPRODUCED (Crucible audit 2026-07-05): the model-selection use (rank) mostly holds; the style bias is in individual votes, not (mostly) the order. Public probe mnemo/probes/arena_style_only.py.

entries.claim: LLM-as-judge (GPT-4) agrees with human preferences ~80% — on par with human-human agreement — so it is a valid stand-in for human quality evaluation (MT-Bench).
entries.source: Zheng et al. 2023, Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena, arXiv:2306.05685
entries.note: Length-confound null on the original released data (lmsys/mt_bench_human_judgments: 3355 human + 2400 GPT-4 pairwise votes). A length-only null (pick the longer answer) agrees with humans 68.1% (words 66.4%), APPARENTLY recovering ~half the judge's above-chance margin (judge=86.3% vs chance 50%). But the pre-registered control -- length-MATCHED pairs (<10% gap) -- REFUTES the 'it's just length' read: GPT-4 still agrees with humans ~80% (79.7%, n=74) while the length-null falls to chance (53.0%). The agreement SURVIVES length-matching, so it is largely semantic (Campbell-Fiske shared-method-variance; 68% is a correlational upper bound, length as a valid PROXY). VERDICT REVISED FAILED->REPRODUCED (Crucible audit 2026-07-05): the folklore holds; length is a real but minority confound, not the driver. Public probe mnemo/probes/llm_judge_length_null.py.

entries.claim: Cosine similarity cannot distinguish a superseded fact from its replacement (the 'supersession blind spot'); a deterministic (subject, relation, object) ledger removes stale-fact recall.
entries.source: Temporal Validity in Retrieval Memory: Eliminating Stale-Fact Errors (Yadav, MemStrata, arXiv:2606.26511)
entries.note: Replicated on local nomic (24 subject-relation-object facts, mean-centered): the cosine 'is-this-a-supersession' classifier scores AUROC 0.613 (chance 0.5; Yadav ~0.59) -- a contradiction is often MORE embedding-similar to the original than a genuine rephrase (10/24 cases). A pure-cosine top-1 store served the stale value 41.7% of the time; a deterministic (subject,relation,object) supersession key drove that to 0% (shipped in mnemo v0.2.0). Falsifier: if the key did not cut stale below cosine it would be useless -- it did. Honest scope: synthetic, 24 facts, characterizes the mechanism, not a product benchmark.

entries.claim: Real-world networks are scale-free: their degree distributions follow a power law p(k) ~ k^-alpha.
entries.source: Barabasi-Albert (1999) framing, widely repeated; rigorous tests: Clauset, Shalizi & Newman 2009; Broido & Clauset 2019 'Scale-Free Networks Are Rare'.
entries.note: Under a rigorous Clauset-Shalizi-Newman fit (MLE alpha, KS-selected xmin, bootstrap goodness-of-fit, Vuong likelihood-ratio vs lognormal, n=20,000): a lognormal that 'looks scale-free' on a log-log plot is correctly REFUSED (power-law GOF p=0.01; LR favors lognormal, -17.5); a genuine Pareto power law passes (GOF p=0.92; LR +102); and a real Barabasi-Albert network is only a TIE (LR -0.1) - power law is not even clearly preferred over lognormal for true preferential attachment. So 'looks scale-free' is not 'is scale-free' and the universal claim is not safely inferable (Broido-Clauset reproduces). Power law IS reproduced for true BA graphs.

entries.claim: Emergent abilities of large language models are genuine, sharp capability transitions - a discontinuous jump in skill above a scale threshold.
entries.source: Wei et al. 2022 'Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models' (claim); counter: Schaeffer, Miranda & Koyejo 2023 'Are Emergent Abilities a Mirage?' (NeurIPS).
entries.note: The canonical SHARP 'emergence' curve is reproduced by a SMOOTH, continuous per-token skill measured with a nonlinear exact-match metric: the same smooth skill gives a per-token transition width 7.0 vs an exact-match (L=100) width 1.05 -- 6.7x sharper PURELY from the metric -- and the apparent onset shifts -0.07 -> +5.58 as answer length grows with NO change in underlying skill. No capability discontinuity is needed, so benchmark sharpness is not evidence for one (Schaeffer et al. 2023 'mirage', NeurIPS Outstanding Paper, reproduces). CONTESTED / scope: shows the metric mechanism is SUFFICIENT to fake sharpness here; it does NOT prove no ability is ever genuinely emergent -- Du et al. 2024 argue downstream abilities track a genuine pretraining-loss threshold. What FAILS is 'benchmark sharpness proves a discontinuity', not all emergence.

entries.claim: Metcalfe's Law: the value of a communications network scales as n^2 (the number of possible pairwise connections)
entries.source: Metcalfe's Law (folklore/Gilder 1993); contested by Briscoe, Odlyzko & Tilly (2006), 'Metcalfe's Law is Wrong' (IEEE Spectrum), and Metcalfe (2013) Facebook dat
entries.note: Fitting V ~ n^alpha: the strong n^2 law holds only under the (unrealistic) assumption that every pairwise connection has EQUAL value (alpha=2.00); under realistic rank-declining value (Zipf 1/k) the theoretical prediction is ~n*log(n) (Briscoe-Odlyzko-Tilly 2006). BUT the exponent is empirically UNSETTLED: real user/revenue data from Facebook & Tencent fit n^2 better than n*log(n) (Zhang, Liu & Xu 2015; Van Hove 2016 upholds), and later work even fits a cube law. VERDICT NOT_COMPUTABLE (revised from FAILED, Crucible audit 2026-07-05): our lab shows n^2 is not FORCED by first principles once connection value declines, but n^2 does not fail EMPIRICALLY -- the headline data go the other way, so no clean REPRODUCED/FAILED is warranted.

entries.claim: Dunning & Kruger (1999): the unskilled systematically overestimate their ability - a metacognitive deficit, shown by the quartile plot (bottom quartile +46pp, top -13pp)
entries.source: Kruger & Dunning, J Pers Soc Psychol 77(6), 1999 - Unskilled and Unaware of It
entries.note: A null model with ZERO metacognitive deficit (identical self-error at every skill level) reproduces the canonical quartile plot AND its asymmetry: bottom quartile +45.8 (DK: +46), top -14.2 (DK: -13) -- pure regression to the mean on a noisy test plus a UNIFORM better-than-average offset. So the quartile plot does NOT by itself demonstrate a metacognitive deficit (Gignac & Zajenkowski 2020; Nuhfer et al. 2017; Fix 2022 autocorrelation critique). Scope: 'people self-assess imperfectly' broadly survives, and whether a residual metacognitive signal remains after the artifact is separately contested (Comment, Intelligence 2023) -- what FAILS is that the dramatic quartile graph PROVES the deficit.

entries.note: Smallest model: heterogeneous mean-field SIS threshold lambda_c=<k>/<k^2>, BA (scale-free) vs ER (homogeneous) at mean degree ~4. BA <k^2> grows with N (45->63 over N=500->20000) so lambda_c shrinks 0.088->0.064, heading to 0 = threshold VA

entries.claim: BA networks N=2000 m=2: removing the top 10% of nodes by degree raises the bond-percolation threshold from p_c=0.174 to 0.776 (severalfold robustness loss under targeted hub removal).
entries.source: Simultaneous Degradation of Percolation and Cascade Robustness Under Targeted Hub Removal (Cachero Sanchez, 2026-03-05)
entries.note: Smallest model: BA(N=2000,m=2), Molloy-Reed p_c=<k>/(<k^2>-<k>) on the empirical degree sequence + a direct bond-percolation sweep (union-find, giant>50%). MECHANISM REPRODUCED: targeted top-10% hub removal raises the threshold several-fold
